name: waifufy
description: Live2D overlay reacts with a motion and voice when a task succeeds, fails, or needs your confirmation.

port.title: Overlay port
port.description: Port of the Waifufy overlay on 127.0.0.1.

overlayExe.title: Overlay executable
overlayExe.description: Started when the overlay is not running.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (s)
minTurnSeconds.description: A finished turn shorter than this does not count as a task.

onFail.title: React on failure
onFail.description: Apologise when a turn dies on an error.

onConfirm.title: React on confirmation
onConfirm.description: Call you over when Claude needs your answer.

onPush.title: React on git push
onPush.description: Report when a git push goes through.

onDanger.title: Warn on destructive commands
onDanger.description: Stop you before a hard reset, force push, rm -rf and the like.
